description: The Department for Housing and Urban Development publishes GIS areas that the provider identifies as potentially eligible for building energy efficiency concessions. The source states that the areas are used with the Building Code of Australia and apply to certain types of buildings. It does not identify those building types in the catalogue description. The modelling role is a spatial regulatory constraint for building-design optimisation. Eligibility for a particular building is not established by this catalogue entry. The regional data are listed on Data.SA in GeoJSON, Shapefile and compressed KML formats, with public access under CC BY 4.0. Catalogue metadata and download headers were checked; files were not opened. Spatial resolution, attribute definitions and the currency of the underlying observations remain unverified. The related Data.SA catalogue record provides the discovery context.
